additional_requirements.title: Test single-use policy for build workers
additional_requirements.text: Ensure that every pipeline that is being run has its own clean, new runner.

additional_requirements.title: Test passing of build worker environments and commands, not pulling
additional_requirements.text: For each build worker, ensure its environment and commands are passed and not pulled.

additional_requirements.title: Test segregation of duties for each build worker
additional_requirements.text: For each build worker, ensure it has the least responsibility possible, preferably only one duty.

additional_requirements.title: Test minimal network connectivity for build workers
additional_requirements.text: Verify that build workers, environment, and any other components have only the required minimum of network connectivity.

additional_requirements.title: Test enforcement of run-time security for build workers
additional_requirements.text: Verify that a run-time security solution is enforced on every active build worker.

additional_requirements.title: Test automatic scanning of build workers for vulnerabilities
additional_requirements.text: For each build worker, ensure the environmental sources it uses are scanned for vulnerabilities.

additional_requirements.title: Test storage of build workers' deployment configuration in a version control platform
additional_requirements.text: Verify that the deployment configuration of build workers is stored in a version control platform.

additional_requirements.title: Test monitoring of resource consumption by build workers
additional_requirements.text: Verify that there is monitoring of resources consumption for each build worker.
